description: Initialize the pearl project and create the full system requirements specification document (系統開發需求書.md) with all 73 sections verbatim as provided by the user.
steps: Create a basic README.md for the pearl project indicating it is PEARL v2 - Constitutional Deterministic Agent Framework

Create 系統開發需求書.md in the pearl project root with the complete specification content (all 73 sections) exactly as provided in the user instruction - this is a very large document covering: document purpose, architecture corrections, framework positioning, 12 constitutional articles, system architecture, Precision Decision Engine (P0-P3), Exactness Gate, Script Runtime, Planner-Executor, Durable Work Plane, Event Ledger, Policy/Guard engines, Scheduler, Runtime Profile, Backend Router, Evidence Model, OODA Governance, Repair Transactions, development quality, CI Gate, project structure, data models, CLI requirements, non-functional requirements, test strategy, DDP migration phases 0-8, and final framework positioning
acceptance_criteria: 系統開發需求書.md exists at /projects/sandbox/pearl/系統開發需求書.md
The document contains all 73 sections from section 1 (文件目的) through section 73 (最終框架定位)
All code blocks, tables, YAML examples, and ASCII architecture diagrams are preserved exactly
README.md exists with basic project description
verification: Run: test -f /projects/sandbox/pearl/系統開發需求書.md && echo 'EXISTS'
Run: grep -c '^# ' /projects/sandbox/pearl/系統開發需求書.md to verify section headers exist (should be 73+)
Run: grep '最終框架定位' /projects/sandbox/pearl/系統開發需求書.md to verify last section present
